target.title: fix(tasks): keep emoji / surrogate pairs intact during terminal output truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The task CLI's shared table truncator used raw UTF-16 slicing. If a supplementary character straddled a column boundary, task list or audit output could contain a dangling surrogate rendered as a replacement character.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the canonical `truncateUtf16Safe` helper while preserving each existing code-unit column cap. Maintainer cleanup also removed the separate `maxChars <= 1` raw-slice branch so all truncated task cells use one bounded path.

## User Impact

Human-readable `openclaw tasks` table cells, including task summaries, remain within their established widths and no longer split emoji or other supplementary characters.

## Evidence

- The regression creates a completed task whose terminal summary straddles the 80-code-unit boundary, runs `tasksListCommand`, and verifies the actual rendered row contains the safe bounded summary.
- Canonical formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview of exact head `e1386490afad956aa26e9393f78ac2ade372afa9`: clean, correctness confidence 0.86.
- Exact-head hosted CI is the merge gate.

AI-assisted.
